pr_title: executor: truncate column values from index KV during admin check
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/23178 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:

```sql
create table t (a text collate utf8mb4_general_ci not null, b int(11) not null, 
  primary key (a(10), b) clustered, key idx(a(2)) ) 
  default charset=utf8mb4 collate=utf8mb4_bin;
insert into t values ("aaa", 2);
```

The key-value contents are:
```
// sk = sortKey, p = prefixed
row record:     sk(aaa), 2              -> aaa
index record:   sk(p(aa)), {sk(aaa), 2} -> restore data(aaa)
```

The error message says that the column value is `aa` from the row record, which is inconsistent with the one `aaa` from the index record:
```
mysql> admin check table t;
ERROR 1105 (HY000): col a, handle &kv.CommonHandle{encoded:[]uint8{0x1, 0x0, 0x41, 0x0, 0x41, 0x0, 0x41, 0x0, 0x0, 0xfd, 0x3, 0x80, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x2}, colEndOffsets:[]uint16{0xa, 0x13}}, index:types.Datum{k:0x5, decimal:0x0, length:0x0, i:0, collation:"utf8mb4_general_ci", b:[]uint8{0x61, 0x61, 0x61}, x:interface {}(nil)} != record:types.Datum{k:0x5, decimal:0x0, length:0x0, i:0, collation:"utf8mb4_general_ci", b:[]uint8{0x61, 0x61}, x:interface {}(nil)}
```

This case is special because column `a` exists in both index values and common handle.

Before reading the row record, `TruncateIndexValues` is invoked. So we should do the same work for the datum read from index record.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed: Truncate column values from index key-value during `admin check`.


### Related changes

NA

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Integration test

Side effects

**Note:**
**This PR relax the check of `ADMIN CHECK`. It is possible that the data is inconsistent but `ADMIN CHECK` shows nothing.**

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- No release note

issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
Enable the new collation
``` sql
set @@tidb_enable_clustered_index=1;
create table t (a text collate utf8mb4_general_ci not null, b int(11) not null, primary key (a(10), b) clustered, key idx(a(2)) ) default charset=utf8mb4 collate=utf8mb4_bin;
insert into t values ("aaa", 2);
admin check table t;
```
### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
Ok
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
``` sql
mysql> admin check table t;
ERROR 1105 (HY000): col a, handle &kv.CommonHandle{encoded:[]uint8{0x1, 0x0, 0x41, 0x0, 0x41, 0x0, 0x41, 0x0, 0x0, 0xfd, 0x3, 0x80, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x2}, colEndOffsets:[]uint16{0xa, 0x13}}, index:types.Datum{k:0x5, decimal:0x0, length:0x0, i:0, collation:"utf8mb4_general_ci", b:[]uint8{0x61, 0x61, 0x61}, x:interface {}(nil)} != record:types.Datum{k:0x5, decimal:0x0, length:0x0, i:0, collation:"utf8mb4_general_ci", b:[]uint8{0x61, 0x61}, x:interface {}(nil)}
```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
master
